info.text:
McDonald's app members rang up $41 billion in one year.
Sales to loyalty members hit $41B in the 12 months to Sept 2026, up from about $20B in 2023.
McDonald's says US customers visited 10.5 times the year before joining and 26 times the year after.
Our math: at 100 points per $1, medium fries (3,500 points since May 2026) take $35 of spending.
Sources: McDonald's earnings releases (2023-2026), Investor Update (Dec 2023), Doctor of Credit.
News and education, not financial advice.
